cuts.speaker: 드워프 사냥꾼
cuts.dialogue:
알카즈 감옥 막보 컷!
드디어 내 민첩 반지
먹을 차례다~
cuts.visual_prompt: High-angle three-quarter shot in a clean 3-to-3.5-head Korean gag webtoon style on pure solid white #FFFFFF background. On the left, the cheerful Dwarf Hunter leans forward excitedly with sparkling eyes and open hands reaching toward a glowing blue-rarity silver ring floating in the center, her blunderbuss slung cleanly on her back. On the right behind her, the sleepy-eyed Undead Paladin quietly reaches for a chunky 6-sided white-and-gold cube showing ONLY classic round dot pips, strictly ZERO digits, ZERO numbers, ZERO letters, her one-handed mace and golden paladin shield stowed on her back. Minimal stone floor lines sit only directly beneath their boots.

cuts.speaker: 드워프 사냥꾼
cuts.dialogue:
잠깐만요, 기사님?!
민첩 반지에 입찰을
왜 누르시는 거예요?!
cuts.visual_prompt: Dynamic wide two-shot in a clean 3-to-3.5-head Korean gag webtoon style on pure solid white #FFFFFF background. On the left, the Dwarf Hunter whips around in shock, leaning forward with wide eyes and pointing frantically at the right character, her blunderbuss strapped to her back. On the right, the Undead Paladin stands utterly unbothered with half-lidded eyes, holding up a chunky 6-sided white-and-gold cube showing ONLY classic round dot pips, strictly ZERO digits, ZERO numbers, ZERO letters, her one-handed mace and golden paladin shield stowed cleanly on her back.

cuts.speaker: 언데드 성기사
cuts.dialogue:
논란이 많은 건 알지만…
기사도 치명타 올리려면
민첩이 필요해요.
cuts.visual_prompt: Dramatic low-angle close-up in a clean 3-to-3.5-head Korean gag webtoon style on pure solid white #FFFFFF background. Centered, the Undead Paladin raises one index finger solemnly like a tired philosopher delivering sacred wisdom, her half-lidded eyes deadpan and serious, with the rim of her golden paladin shield peeking behind her shoulder and both hands free of weapons.

Wide deadpan freeze-frame reaction shot in a clean 3-to-3.5-head Korean gag webtoon style on pure solid white #FFFFFF background. Side by side, the Dwarf Hunter on the left and the Skyborn Mage on the right stand completely petrified like statues with tiny blank dot eyes, slack jaws, and stiff postures, blunderbuss and mage staff cleanly strapped to their backs. Tiny silent sweat drops and faint vertical shock lines hover above their heads.

cuts.speaker: 스카이본 마법사
cuts.dialogue:
아~ 그럼 법사도 회피율
올려야 하니까 다음엔
민첩 템 입찰할게요.
cuts.visual_prompt: Side-profile over-the-shoulder shot in a clean 3-to-3.5-head Korean gag webtoon style on pure solid white #FFFFFF background. On the left, the Skyborn Mage flashes a chillingly polite, forced smile with narrowed starry eyes and an irked tick mark on her temple, holding up a chunky 6-sided white-and-gold cube showing ONLY classic round dot pips, strictly ZERO digits, ZERO numbers, ZERO letters, her staff stowed on her back. On the right, the Orc Warrior listens with wide, overly earnest eyes and nods excitedly in agreement, her axe stowed on her back.

cuts.speaker: 드워프 사냥꾼
cuts.dialogue:
에라 몰라! 전사는 지능 천템,
냥꾼은 힘 템 다 굴려!
알카즈 감옥 올입 가자!!
cuts.visual_prompt: Wide energetic finale shot in a clean 3-to-3.5-head Korean gag webtoon style on pure solid white #FFFFFF background. On the left, the Orc Warrior pumps both fists excitedly in wild agreement with shining eyes, weapons stowed on her back. On the right, the Dwarf Hunter throws her arms up in exasperated chaos, tossing a couple of chunky 6-sided white-and-gold cubes showing ONLY classic round dot pips, strictly ZERO digits, ZERO numbers, ZERO letters into the air, her blunderbuss stowed on her back.
